subject.title: feat(control-ui): add cron calendar timeline view

question: Should OpenClaw accept a repaired narrow 24-hour Cron timeline as the first core Control UI slice, or pause this PR until the broader calendar/week/editing scope is designed?
rationale: The linked issue asks for a broader calendar/timeline product surface, while this PR implements a narrower slice and now needs a rebase plus contract fixes before merge.

options.title: Accept a Narrow Timeline Slice
options.body: Adopt the 24-hour timeline after it is rebased and the status, scheduler, state-color, and i18n blockers are fixed.

options.title: Pause for Full Calendar Design
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and ask for a fuller daily/week/editing design before accepting implementation.

options.title: Request a Replacement Branch
options.body: Close or pause this stale branch after asking for a fresh PR against the current cron page architecture.

recommendation.title: Accept a Narrow Timeline Slice
recommendation.body: Adopt the 24-hour timeline after it is rebased and the status, scheduler, state-color, and i18n blockers are fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is a Control UI product-surface call, and recent cron UI/style history plus the existing canonical review make steipete the best available routing candidate from the sampled owners.
